accounting_notes: The six V11 220-row endpoints are separate from the V10 44-row task-1 monitor; no cross-population accuracy comparison is emitted.
Missing work counters remain null; group totals are null whenever any run is unknown.
Checkpoint files are streamed for SHA-256/size verification only; no torch deserialization or state loading occurs.
No dataset rows or official-test payload are opened.
The V11 extra gold-target access flag describes the frozen objective intervention, not a general data-provenance audit.

scope.extra_label_access_basis: Frozen V11 intervention gates the Eq4 reward using canonical-label validity; it adds no gold-target loss. Development labels are used only in the fixed scorer.

v10_legacy_task1_monitor_not_comparable.note: V10 task-1 monitor uses 2 development examples/class; its metrics are intentionally omitted and are not comparable to the V11 220-row endpoint.
